Hi all — longtime admirer of this community, finally introducing myself. I'm Ben O'Connor, a math PhD (University of Chicago — representation theory, configuration/moduli spaces). I came to Lean through an autoformalization project: scoping a pipeline to translate research-level mathematics into Lean, aiming at a graduate-level benchmark beyond the usual competition-style problems.

These days I'm working at the intersection of formal methods and AI — building tooling that translates ordinary source code into a structured mathematical representation you can actually run analysis and proofs against. Lean and the formalization world are a big part of what shaped how I think about it.

Mostly here to learn from people far deeper in Lean than I am, and to follow the autoformalization and proof-automation discussions. Happy to be here.
